plan.reason: The forecast predicts a warm day with temperatures dropping below 16°C in the afternoon. The warmest zone is already at 26.2°C, indicating that cooling will be needed soon. Given the forecast and the need to avoid overheating while also saving energy by not overcooling, setting the ceiling at 14.0°C provides a balance. This temperature allows for some margin in case of slight temperature fluctuations but ensures that zones do not overheat during the warmest part of the day.
